description: This file contains utility functions and types for spawning and managing child processes, including resolving commands, handling execution environment, and managing process lifecycle in a Node.js environment.

methods.name: resolveSpawnCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command to be executed, handling shebang scripts, Windows-specific policies, and caching logic.

methods.name: spawnWithResolvedCommand
methods.description: Spawns a child process with a command resolved by resolveSpawnCommand, setting environment variables and process options.

methods.name: waitForExit
methods.description: Waits for a child process to exit and returns its exit code, signal, and error if any.

methods.name: spawnAndCollect
methods.description: Spawns a process, collects stdout and stderr output, and handles process termination and abort signals.

methods.name: resolveSpawnFailure
methods.description: Determines if a spawn failure was due to missing command or missing directory based on error code.
